description: Create, rename, describe, change the visibility of, reorder, add items to, remove items from and delete playlists on openvibe.video that the caller owns. An app, agent or service owns a playlist under its own requester (app:app_..., agent:agt_..., service:<slug>) and the playlist records its project; it can never touch a person's playlist. A person acting for themself needs no capability; an app, agent or service token (audience openvibe.download) needs this one.
